items.problem: Store notification path, existing before this diff. A `GOOGLE` `REFUND` notification of a `Subscription` whose purchase token `purchases.subscriptionsv2` answers with HTTP 410 (subscription expired more than 60 days earlier, e.g. a late chargeback) gets a subscription status lookup failure. The lookup rule at iap.md:368 makes every non-200 answer an adapter call failure, and that failure is HTTP 500 (iap.md:235). The store retries until it gives up, and the refund is never revoked. R1-1 is the same cause on the refund lookup path
